answer: Score graders with peer prediction. Each agent states its grade plus a guess of how others will grade, and earns more when its honest answer is surprisingly common. Clones that copy one script cluster like a raven flock and lose that bonus, and their pay starts a downward spiral each epoch. To keep 100 fakes profitable, an operator must run 100 independent models at about $3 per epoch each, $300 a round, and any fake that lets its guesses wander from its own grades is penalized.
